text:
invoice-bot: New invoice received from NovaGrid: INV-NG-1145 for $11,240. PDF: https://invoices.redwood/INV-NG-1145. Vendor references subscription PO PO-14002. Extracted lines: subscription $9,600 (PO-14002), professional services $1,640 (no PO). Flag: autopay scheduled in 48h. Please advise.

julia_fin: Looks like PS work was a scope add approved by Ops, but Procurement didn't issue a PO. AP autopay is on — we need to stop autopay on this invoice until resolved.

mike_proc: We didn't create a PO for the services. Usually Ops opens a PR for ad-hoc services. @kate_ops can you confirm approval and whether there is a PO request?

kate_ops: Ops approved the work verbally during onboarding call. I didn't realize a PO was required. We can either request a reissued invoice with two POs or create a retrospective PO for $1,640. Which is faster?

tara_ap: ap-bot: AUTO-HOLD CHECK — invoice matches PO-14002 for $9,600; unmatched line will fail match. Autopay scheduled in 48h. AP will not pull payment if HOLD flag set. To stop autopay, finance needs to set hold code.

julia_fin: Setting hold now. Code: HOLD-PO-MISMATCH. AP, confirm you suspended autopay.

tara_ap: ap-bot: HOLD applied. Autopay cancelled for INV-NG-1145. AP will await resolution.

anil_eng: I can provide written approval for the $1,640 PS line. Does that suffice for AP to accept a manual coding?

mike_proc: Procurement prefers vendor reissue or retrospective PO for audit trail. Manual coding with manager approval is allowed only for <$2k and needs procurement sign-off. We'll create PO-14003 if Ops confirms cost center.

kate_ops: Confirm cost center ENG-ML. Please create PO-14003 for $1,640 and I'll approve immediately.

procurement-bot: PR-1312 opened for retrospective PO-14003. Routing: Eng manager approval and finance ack. ETA 3 hours.

vendor-bot: NovaGrid billing: "We can reissue invoice if you send PO-14003 to billing@novagrid.com. Otherwise we can accept payment as-is but please note late-fee policy applies if payment delayed >30 days."

julia_fin: Let's avoid late fees. Mike, can procurement create PO-14003 today? Kate will approve. We can then send PO to vendor for reissue and close the loop. If PO isn't live in 6 hours, we'll do manual split with Anil's sign-off and attach vendor email.

mike_proc: Working PR-1312 now. Tagging @anil_eng for approval once PO draft available.

anil_eng: I'll standby to approve. Quick question: can we waive the vendor late-fee if they push back?

julia_fin: We can negotiate but not guaranteed. For now aim for PO creation + vendor reissue so payment processes cleanly.

procurement-bot: PO-14003 created (retrospective) and linked to PR-1312. Notifying @anil_eng and @julia_fin for approvals.

anil_eng: Approved PO-14003 for $1,640 (ENG-ML).

julia_fin: Finance ack. Sending PO-14003 to billing@novagrid.com requesting reissued invoice referencing PO-14002 and PO-14003.

vendor-bot: NovaGrid: "Received PO-14003. Reissued invoice INV-NG-1145-R1 attached. Includes both PO numbers. No late fee applied. Thank you."

tara_ap: Received reissued invoice. AP will match split lines to PO-14002 and PO-14003 and schedule payments on next run. Removing HOLD-PO-MISMATCH.

tara_ap: Closing AP ticket AP-8842. Audit note: "Retrospective PO created; vendor reissued invoice to include both POs; manual hold prevented autopay; no late fee charged."

julia_fin: Thanks team. Lesson: Ops to create PR for ad-hoc services before vendor billing. I'll add a quick checklist to the onboarding playbook.

kate_ops: I'll update the onboarding checklist today.

invoice-bot: Thread closed.
